summary: Auth compatibility with installs of the earlier library entry (Greptile PR #2450 round 2 P1; orchestrator decisions after Codex novel1219-r7 and r9: Load never writes; no file deletion and no removal of old keys anywhere). READ: CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH, then CONDUYT_API_KEY (a set name decides, blank = cleared, an unresolved MCP placeholder does not count; legacy names print one deprecation line). Saved bearer_auth / api_key are read by the existing checked-descriptor loaders as extra fields of the same document only when crm_bearer_auth is ABSENT from it (present even empty = cleared): cliutil.Credentials / decodeCredentialsDocument for credentials files (HasValues counts them, so an unsafe legacy-only file is a present refusal that suppresses the global fallback), applyLegacyConfigKey inside parseConfigData for the config document. WRITE: auth set-token (Config.SaveBearerToken) saves crm_bearer_auth, the bearer key AuthHeader ranks above access_token, through the existing saver (global credentials file, config document) and, for an explicit profile whose credentials file exists, into that file with cliutil.SetProfileBearer; auth logout (ClearTokens) writes crm_bearer_auth = "" there the same way. SetProfileBearer changes only crm_bearer_auth, anchored to one O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY descriptor of the profile data directory (openat read verified, O_EXCL owner-only temp verified through its descriptor, renameat); an untrusted or symlinked profile is left alone; on Windows an existing profile file is refused with a message. The env var logout reports comes from config.EffectiveAuthEnv, Load's own rule. cliutil/credentials.go and cliutil/creds_profile_write_*.go are generator-owned territory: this patch must be re-applied on a reprint.
reason: The 4.34.2 reprint reads only CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and crm_bearer_auth; existing installs that use the earlier env names or saved keys would lose authentication on upgrade.
validated_outcome: TestLegacyAuthEnvPrecedence (incl. blank names), TestLegacyAuthConfigKeysReadInPlace, TestLegacyAuthCredentialsFilesReadInPlace, TestLegacyAuthUnsafeProfileFileSuppressesGlobalFallback, TestLegacyAuthMixedDocumentKeepsFieldPrecedence, TestLegacyAuthTrustOutcomesMatchTheCurrentKey, TestLegacyAuthUntrustedConfigFileIsRefused, TestLegacyAuthSavesNeverWriteLegacyKeys, TestLegacyAuthEmptyCurrentKeyNeverResurrectsALegacyKey, TestLegacyAuthReSaveSendsTheNewToken (legacy profile key, env overlay at save time, mixed profile with an older access_token), TestLegacyAuthLogoutClearsWithoutDeleting, TestLegacyAuthLogoutDoesNotFollowASymlinkedProfileDataDir, TestLegacyAuthHasNoFileDeletionPath and TestAuthLogoutReportsLegacyEnvNames (current, both legacy names, MCP placeholder cases, blank current) pass with no secret in any output; the FULL live gate passes with CONDUYT_CRM_BEARER_AUTH and with only CONDUYT_BEARER_AUTH.
